datasets.name: summary
queryLines:
-- One row: the four headline tiles. Every number is read from a published table, never
-- recomputed here from bronze - the tiles are cross-checked against bronze by hand in M4-S1.
WITH hours AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT interval_start_utc) AS hours_loaded,
         date_format(min(interval_start_utc), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:00') AS first_hour,
         date_format(max(interval_start_utc), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:00') AS last_hour
    FROM gold.agg_company_share_of_traffic
),
wiki AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(hours_observed), 0) AS domain_hours,
         coalesce(sum(lifetime_views), 0) AS total_views
    FROM gold.dim_wiki
),
fact AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS fact_rows, coalesce(sum(views), 0) AS company_views
    FROM gold.fct_company_pageviews_hourly
),
recon AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS hours_reconciled,
         coalesce(sum(domains), 0) AS domain_hours_reconciled,
         coalesce(sum(mismatched_domains), 0) AS domains_off
    FROM ops.reconciliation
)
SELECT hours.hours_loaded,
       hours.first_hour,
       hours.last_hour,
       wiki.total_views,
       round(wiki.total_views / 1e6, 1) AS million_views_analysed,
       fact.company_views,
       round(100 * fact.company_views / nullif(wiki.total_views, 0), 4) AS tracked_share_pct,
       recon.hours_reconciled,
       recon.domain_hours_reconciled,
       recon.domains_off
  FROM hours CROSS JOIN wiki CROSS JOIN fact CROSS JOIN recon

datasets.name: company_hourly
datasets.displayName: Views and share of all traffic, per company per hour
queryLines:
-- gold.agg_company_share_of_traffic whole: seven companies x a few thousand hours at most.
SELECT interval_start_utc,
       company_name,
       company_views,
       total_views,
       round(100 * share_of_traffic, 5) AS share_of_traffic_pct
  FROM gold.agg_company_share_of_traffic

datasets.name: languages
datasets.displayName: Views per language edition, per company, long tail folded
queryLines:
-- Top 12 language editions per company, the rest folded into one "Other" bar - folded, not
-- dropped, so the bars still account for every view (wikiflow's metrics.language_breakdown).
WITH per_language AS (
  SELECT company_name, coalesce(wiki_language, '(none)') AS language, sum(views) AS views
    FROM gold.fct_company_pageviews_hourly
   GROUP BY company_name, coalesce(wiki_language, '(none)')
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY company_name ORDER BY views DESC, language) AS rank,
         count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY company_name) AS editions
    FROM per_language
)
SELECT company_name,
       CASE WHEN rank <= 12 THEN language ELSE concat('Other (', editions - 12, ' editions)') END AS language,
       sum(views) AS views
  FROM ranked
 GROUP BY company_name, CASE WHEN rank <= 12 THEN language ELSE concat('Other (', editions - 12, ' editions)') END

datasets.name: access
datasets.displayName: Mobile and redirect share of each company's views
queryLines:
SELECT company_name,
       sum(views) AS views,
       round(100 * sum(CASE WHEN access_method = 'mobile-web' THEN views ELSE 0 END) / nullif(sum(views), 0), 1) AS mobile_share_pct,
       round(100 * sum(CASE WHEN match_type = 'redirect' THEN views ELSE 0 END) / nullif(sum(views), 0), 1) AS redirect_share_pct
  FROM gold.fct_company_pageviews_hourly
 GROUP BY company_name

datasets.name: health
queryLines:
-- From the audit trail: one row per attempt, failures included. Timing uses ingests only:
-- hours rebuilt from raw skip the download and would make the median read fast.
SELECT count(*) AS attempts,
       count_if(status <> 'success') AS failed_attempts,
       round(percentile(CASE WHEN task_key = 'ingest_hour' AND status = 'success' THEN duration_seconds END, 0.5), 0) AS median_ingest_seconds,
       date_format(max(CASE WHEN task_key = 'ingest_hour' AND status = 'success' THEN finished_at END), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS last_successful_ingest_utc
  FROM ops.ingest_audit

datasets.name: attempts
queryLines:
SELECT date_format(started_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS attempted_utc,
       date_format(interval_start_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:00') AS hour_utc,
       CASE task_key WHEN 'ingest_hour' THEN 'Ingested' WHEN 'reprocess_hour' THEN 'Rebuilt from raw' ELSE task_key END AS how,
       attempt,
       status,
       round(duration_seconds, 0) AS seconds,
       line_count,
       company_rows,
       domains_mismatched,
       coalesce(error, '') AS error
  FROM ops.ingest_audit
 ORDER BY started_at DESC
 LIMIT 50

datasets.name: quality
datasets.displayName: The latest result of each quality check
queryLines:
SELECT check_name,
       status,
       date_format(checked_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS checked_utc,
       detail
  FROM (
    SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY check_name ORDER BY checked_at DESC) AS newest
      FROM ops.quality_results
  )
 WHERE newest = 1

datasets.name: cost_by_workload
datasets.displayName: DBUs per day per workload of this target
queryLines:
WITH target AS (
  -- The dashboard runs in its target's catalog (dataset_catalog), so the catalog names the target
  -- whose workloads to cost. system tables themselves are account-wide.
  SELECT CASE current_catalog() WHEN 'wikiflow_sbx' THEN 'sandbox' WHEN 'wikiflow_dev' THEN 'dev' ELSE 'prod' END AS name
),
pipelines AS (
  SELECT pipeline_id, name FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
usage AS (
  SELECT u.usage_date,
         u.usage_end_time,
         coalesce(u.usage_metadata.job_name, p.name) AS workload,
         u.usage_quantity AS dbus
    FROM system.billing.usage AS u
    LEFT JOIN pipelines AS p ON p.pipeline_id = u.usage_metadata.dlt_pipeline_id
   CROSS JOIN target
   WHERE u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
     AND coalesce(u.usage_metadata.job_name, p.name) LIKE concat('wikiflow%', target.name)
)
SELECT usage_date, workload, round(sum(dbus), 3) AS dbus
  FROM usage
 GROUP BY usage_date, workload

datasets.name: cost_per_hour
datasets.displayName: DBUs per ingested hour, per day
queryLines:
WITH target AS (
  -- The dashboard runs in its target's catalog (dataset_catalog), so the catalog names the target
  -- whose workloads to cost. system tables themselves are account-wide.
  SELECT CASE current_catalog() WHEN 'wikiflow_sbx' THEN 'sandbox' WHEN 'wikiflow_dev' THEN 'dev' ELSE 'prod' END AS name
),
pipelines AS (
  SELECT pipeline_id, name FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
usage AS (
  SELECT u.usage_date,
         u.usage_end_time,
         coalesce(u.usage_metadata.job_name, p.name) AS workload,
         u.usage_quantity AS dbus
    FROM system.billing.usage AS u
    LEFT JOIN pipelines AS p ON p.pipeline_id = u.usage_metadata.dlt_pipeline_id
   CROSS JOIN target
   WHERE u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
     AND coalesce(u.usage_metadata.job_name, p.name) LIKE concat('wikiflow%', target.name)
),
per_day AS (
  SELECT usage_date,
         sum(CASE WHEN workload LIKE 'wikiflow_ingest_hours_%' THEN dbus END) AS ingest_dbus,
         sum(CASE WHEN workload LIKE 'wikiflow_pageviews_%' THEN dbus END)    AS pipeline_dbus
    FROM usage
   GROUP BY usage_date
),
hours AS (
  -- Successful ingests of an hour, re-ingests included: each one is work the ingest job paid for.
  -- Only those finished before billing's newest record: billing lags, and counting hours whose
  -- DBUs are not billed yet would understate the rate for the newest day.
  SELECT to_date(finished_at) AS usage_date, count(*) AS hours_ingested
    FROM ops.ingest_audit
   WHERE task_key = 'ingest_hour' AND status = 'success'
     AND finished_at <= (SELECT max(usage_end_time) FROM usage)
   GROUP BY to_date(finished_at)
)
SELECT h.usage_date,
       h.hours_ingested,
       round(coalesce(d.ingest_dbus, 0), 3)                          AS ingest_dbus,
       round(coalesce(d.pipeline_dbus, 0), 3)                        AS pipeline_dbus,
       round(coalesce(d.ingest_dbus, 0) / h.hours_ingested, 4)       AS ingest_dbus_per_hour,
       round(coalesce(d.pipeline_dbus, 0) / h.hours_ingested, 4)     AS pipeline_dbus_per_hour
  FROM hours AS h
  JOIN per_day AS d USING (usage_date)

datasets.name: cost_summary
datasets.displayName: DBUs per ingested hour over every day billed, one row
queryLines:
WITH target AS (
  -- The dashboard runs in its target's catalog (dataset_catalog), so the catalog names the target
  -- whose workloads to cost. system tables themselves are account-wide.
  SELECT CASE current_catalog() WHEN 'wikiflow_sbx' THEN 'sandbox' WHEN 'wikiflow_dev' THEN 'dev' ELSE 'prod' END AS name
),
pipelines AS (
  SELECT pipeline_id, name FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
usage AS (
  SELECT u.usage_date,
         u.usage_end_time,
         coalesce(u.usage_metadata.job_name, p.name) AS workload,
         u.usage_quantity AS dbus
    FROM system.billing.usage AS u
    LEFT JOIN pipelines AS p ON p.pipeline_id = u.usage_metadata.dlt_pipeline_id
   CROSS JOIN target
   WHERE u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
     AND coalesce(u.usage_metadata.job_name, p.name) LIKE concat('wikiflow%', target.name)
),
hours AS (
  SELECT to_date(finished_at) AS usage_date, count(*) AS hours_ingested
    FROM ops.ingest_audit
   WHERE task_key = 'ingest_hour' AND status = 'success'
     AND finished_at <= (SELECT max(usage_end_time) FROM usage)
   GROUP BY to_date(finished_at)
),
billed AS (
  -- Only days both sides know: billing lags, and the audit may hold days billing has not reached.
  SELECT usage_date,
         sum(CASE WHEN workload LIKE 'wikiflow_ingest_hours_%' THEN dbus END) AS ingest_dbus,
         sum(CASE WHEN workload LIKE 'wikiflow_pageviews_%' THEN dbus END)    AS pipeline_dbus
    FROM usage
   GROUP BY usage_date
)
SELECT sum(h.hours_ingested)                                                   AS hours_ingested,
       round(sum(b.ingest_dbus), 3)                                            AS ingest_dbus,
       round(sum(b.ingest_dbus) / sum(h.hours_ingested), 4)                    AS ingest_dbus_per_hour,
       round(sum(b.pipeline_dbus) / sum(h.hours_ingested), 4)                  AS pipeline_dbus_per_hour,
       (SELECT date_format(max(usage_end_time), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') FROM usage) AS billed_through_utc
  FROM hours AS h
  JOIN billed AS b USING (usage_date)

# Attention on Wikipedia

How public attention to seven big tech entities moves hour by hour across every language edition of Wikipedia, and what share of all Wikimedia traffic it is. 
Every panel reads the gold marts or the ops tables; `ops.reconciliation` compares every loaded hour with Wikimedia's own projectviews, domain by domain, and a single view off fails the pipeline update.
